quand: Sent by the Orders and making agent when an order takes longer to make: one message per order and per delay.
preheader: Its making needs a little more time.

suivi.description: The order tracking link (no account needed)

blocs.texte:
Hello {prenom},

Your order {commande} is in the hands of our artisans. Its making is taking a little longer than planned, and we would rather tell you now.

We will write as soon as your piece is ready, with its shipping date. If you have a question, simply reply to this message.

You can follow your order here: {suivi}

With all our care,
The Awrea Paris atelier
